process.title: A system that puts the AI to the test
process.intro: Everything was made with Claude, with two kinds of checks: the code stops the build if a hand-written digit appears or if the data contradicts what the text takes as true, and a verifier agent reviews what the code can't see, such as unsupported causes or sources copying each other.

brief.title: Understanding the brief
brief.body: I analyzed the brief and the role with Claude. We set the period, an audience with no financial background and little time, which metrics to look at and what to leave out: predictions and recommendations.

plan.title: Planning before building
plan.body: Claude proposed a plan and waited for my approval. While planning, it noticed that the Veterans Day holiday closes the bond market but not the stock market, and that the checks had to account for it.

data.title: Data with a safety net
data.body: The scripts download the FRED series, store each file with its fingerprint and recalculate everything independently to compare. Yahoo Finance is used only as a check, never to fill in data.

render.title: No market figure written by hand
render.body: The story is a template with markers filled from the data. If a digit appears outside the markers and a short list of allowed phrases, or if the data stops meeting one of the conditions the text takes as true, the build fails. The digit check stopped Claude's first draft.

agents.title: Three agents with separate roles
agents.body: One runs the data and doesn't interpret it. Another researches what happened each day, with a date and a link. A verifier can reject claims: causes without evidence, a single source, sources copying each other, wrong dates.

run.title: The first run
run.body: The verifier rejected claims with a single source, wrong dates and unsupported causes, several of them written by Claude, and found a bug in the code. FRED had not yet published the original plan's last day for three of the five series and the system didn't fill anything in: that is why the period ends one day earlier.

site.title: This site
site.body: Static and bilingual, built with Astro. It reads the same files the pipeline produces and goes through the same checks, in both languages.
